content:
I'd like to announce leanpostgres which is intended to be for Postgres what leansqlite is for SQLite.

It's not a drop-in replacement for leansqlite: instead it provides a Postgres-native API in the style of leansqlite (so, for example, it uses Postgres' $ for placeholders instead of SQLite's ?).

It completely or partially duplicates quite a bit of leansqlite code, which would be great to factor out at some stage.

Geat work! One quick feedback.

Unlike sqlite that is synchronous by design, Postgres can be made asynchronous.
So i don't know if you could use Lean Async instead of just sync IO ? internally your bindings would return Lean promises.
That is a good thought. I didn't need asynchrony for my use case, but it shouldn't be too hard to add. I'll see what I can do...
I've just released a v0.3.0 of this library, which adds connection pooling.
